variants.about_this_item:
• for dogs, cats and other small animals

Teeth brushing made easy Whether dog, cat or small animal - clean and healthy teeth are always important. However, since brushing their teeth can sometimes feel strange for our pets or they are not used to it, our disposable easy-to-use dental care finger pads are recommended. With this handy alternative to a toothbrush, the teeth of your four-legged friend can be cleaned easily and gently. The finger pads, which are coated with nourishing cleaning lotion (mint flavour), can easily be pulled over index finger and thumb and are ready for use - whether at home or on the go.
